fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2016 Infiniti QX60 SUV.
findings: Dust and road film across the black paint on the hood, front bumper and doors
Dirt and grime on the lower front bumper and around the chrome lower trim
Light haze and water spotting visible on the black hood finish in sunlight
Brown leather front seats look dry with visible creasing and wear on the driver seat bolster and cushion
Dust on the center console and dash trim
Seller notes it needs a good wash
message: Hi Jay, we saw your listing for the QX60. The black paint is showing dust and some haze on the hood and lower bumper, and the leather seats could use a clean and condition. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a wash, light buff on the paint and an interior clean. Would you like a quote?
